Cornucopia - More Crops[/b] is a reimagining of MizuJakkaru's [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/more-crops-mod-even-more-crops-mod-updated-20-04.111944/]More Crops Mod[/url], fully rewritten for Content Patcher on Stardew Valley 1.6. It has all the crops and trees you know and love, as well as brand new crops, growable bushes, and new features; all using lovingly updated artwork from Mizu and 6480!

The Cornucopia mod series are customizable. Check out the mod images to adjust your experience!

[list]
[*]90+ crop and 35+ tree species and their associated produce
[*]Berry bushes and mushroom stumps that can be planted and remain out of season, producing yearly when the weather is right[i].[/i]
[/list][i]
Bushes and planters act like vanilla teabushes, meaning they don't need watering, should be planted in untilled soil, and typically take a while to mature.

[/i][list]
[*]Several new paddy crops, and wild trees that can be found in the world
[*]Some new giant crops
[*]Vanilla-minded artisan good additions for appropriate crops, such as flours and alternative methods of obtaining oil, sugar, and cloth
[*]Toggles to enable crops and trees by user desires (See [url=https://github.com/MizuJakkaru/Cornucopia/blob/main/README.md#configuring-cornucopia][b]Configuring Cornucopia[/b][/url]﻿)
[/list]
It is recommended to play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20340]Growable Forage and Crop Bushes[/url] to match Cornucopia bushes. [i]Please be aware that Growable Forage will change the function of certain vanilla crops like blueberries.[/i][center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img]﻿[/b][/center][b]
[/b]This is a brief overview of some of the config settings included in this mod. We recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure your mod.

Cornucopia - More Crops comes with an automatically-enabled set of 17 iconic crops and 4 fruit trees. If you desire more than that, you can turn on the following options:

[b]Enable Extended Crops Pack (Recommended): [/b]Adds an additional 40+ crops and bushes on top of the essential set.
[b]Enable Extended Trees Pack (Recommended): [/b]Adds an additional 30+ fruit trees and 2 wild (tapper) trees.
[b]Enable Herbs Pack: [/b]Adds 20+ new herbs as crops and fruit trees.[center]
[b][img]https://imgur.com/Z3PY4Wr.png[/img][/b][/center][b][b]
Q: Can I install or uninstall this mod in an existing game?
A: Absolutely.[/b] [/b]This mod can be safely added or removed to any save file. You will not miss out on any content by adding it to an existing save. If you decide to remove the mod, any leftover items can be safely thrown away.[b]

Q: Is Cornucopia a sequel to PPJA?
A  [/b]While some of our crops may be familiar to users of PPJA, both mods are actually based on [b][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]MizuJakkaru's original sprites for SDV[/url][/b], back in the days of xnb modding. As such, there may be many differences in content, as they're two different spins on the same foundation. If you're interested in seeing what exactly is included, check out our[b] [/b][url=https://stardewcornucopia.wiki.gg/][b]wiki[/b][/url]!

[b]Q: Is Cornucopia compatible with [insert mod here]?
A: [/b]Cornucopia is technically compatible with [i]any[/i] other mod, even those that add the same items. However, you may have different versions of the same crops if you have multiple large crop expansion mods. If these bother you, consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to turn off certain packs in this mod. For Stardew Valley Expanded, there is a config option to remove 'duplicate' items.

[b]Q: Do I need to download all the Cornucopia mods?
A:[/b] Not at all! In fact, [i]any[/i] of the Cornucopia mods can be played with entirely by themselves. Please feel free to play the way you like best.
